registry.description: Appetite in this registry is carried by a Hebrew word that means alive or living, which is broader than appetite in the narrow sense. It covers the full range of what it means to be a living, creaturely being: vitality, physical energy, the life-force that animates. Appetite as hunger or craving is the narrowest end of this range. The wider meaning signals that the drive to consume and press toward what sustains life is not a defect of the human condition but is bound up with being alive at all.
